about: Generation briefs for the video editor's starter sticker library. Each sticker is one Nano Banana Pro (gemini-3-pro-image) image job in AZ Studio, painted on a flat chroma-key background and cut out afterwards by cutout.py, because the model returns opaque images. The app reads the published stickers from Firestore `videoStickers`.
style: A single die-cut sticker in a bold, friendly flat vector illustration style: thick smooth dark indigo outlines (#23204A), a vivid warm palette of sunset orange (#F28C28), golden yellow (#F4C430), coral red (#EF5B4C), teal blue (#1FA2A6), deep indigo (#2D2A6E) and cream white (#FFF6E6), with simple flat cel shading. A clean, continuous, solid white die-cut border of even width surrounds the whole shape. No drop shadow, no glow, no outer gradient, no texture. One sticker only, centred, filling about 70% of the square frame with generous empty margin on every side.

backgrounds.green: The background is a perfectly flat, uniform, pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) from edge to edge: no texture, no shadow, no vignette, no floor, no frame and no other objects. Do not use any green inside the sticker itself.
backgrounds.magenta: The background is a perfectly flat, uniform, pure chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF) from edge to edge: no texture, no shadow, no vignette, no floor, no frame and no other objects. Do not use any magenta or pink inside the sticker itself.

textRule: Any lettering must be spelled exactly as given, in bold rounded sans-serif capital letters with high contrast, perfectly legible, and there must be no other words, letters or numbers anywhere.
noTextRule: There is no text, lettering, numbers or logos anywhere in the image.
